question: You have a day to help a local project. Where do you go?

options.label: A community kitchen helping families eat well
A group making streets greener and safer
A workshop helping people learn new skills
A service helping people get healthcare

question: A business asks for your help. Which brief do you pick?

options.label: Make jobs safer, fairer and better paid
Cut waste and make its environmental reporting useful
Switch its buildings to cleaner energy
Build affordable tools that more people can use

question: You can join one campaign. What would you work on?

options.label: Make public decisions more open and accountable
Give women equal rights and opportunities
Help people who are excluded get a fair chance
Bring organisations together to solve a shared problem

question: Which environmental project would hold your attention?

options.label: Restore forests and protect wildlife
Keep plastic and pollution out of the sea
Make drinking water clean and reliable
Help communities prepare for a changing climate

question: A neighbourhood has funding to spend. What would you put first?

options.label: Affordable homes and support with basic living costs
Spaces where neighbours can meet and shape local plans
Learning and job opportunities for young people
Food growing and access to healthy meals

question: Which change would you most like to see in everyday life?

options.label: Less waste, more repair and reuse
Clean energy that everyone can afford
Healthcare and mental health support within reach
Services designed so nobody is shut out

question: Which task would you be most keen to take on?

options.label: Bring residents, businesses and public services together
Help a business measure and explain its sustainability work
Help people understand their rights and challenge unfairness
Test practical ways to protect nature and use fewer resources

question: A year later, which result would make you want to keep going?

options.label: People have more secure incomes and better working lives
More people can learn, stay healthy and take part
Communities have more say and organisations work together
We use fewer resources and put less pressure on the planet
